mapper.select:
SELECT fc.id id, fc.`name` `name`, fc.fault_type_id faultTypeId, fc.fault_type_name faultTypeName, fc.device_type_id deviceTypeId, fc.device_type_name deviceTypeName, fc.fault_phenomenon faultPhenomenon, fc.fault_reason faultReason, fc.treatment_measures treatmentMeasures, fc.product_category_code productCategoryCode, b.num faultCount FROM fault_case fc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fault_case_id, COUNT( id ) num FROM fault_closed GROUP BY fault_case_id ) b ON fc.id = b.fault_case_id
and fc.name like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
and fc.product_category_code like concat('%',#{param.productCategoryCode},'%')
and fc.fault_type_id = #{param.faultTypeId}
order by faultCount DESC
